units.note: M0 placeholder; replaced by researched organisation tables in M1/M2. Owner review needed.

Dismounted Schuetzentrupp of a Panzergrenadiergruppe on Puma: research default chosen by the owner 2026-11-11 (he corrects it afterwards). Ranks per position are not confirmed by sources. Five G36 magazines per the published instructor quote; hand grenades reduced from 'five' to two or three. See docs/research/squads.md. The machine gunner carries part of the belts himself; the rest are carried by other men (handing them over arrives with ammunition sharing in M4). D1 (2026-11-14): every man carries one smoke hand grenade (game value, low; sources do not give the issue per man). M9.2: the marksman carries the Trupp's thermal weapon sight (research default, low). Ranks (owner 2026-11-15, "realistic job distribution"): a deployed professional unit of SaZ, so no Gefreiter (3 to 6 months of service) in a combat post; one most typical rank per slot (DECISIONS.md 2026-11-15 realistic ranks; medium at most). Truppfuehrer (deputy of the Gruppenfuehrer, who commands the Puma): Stabsunteroffizier (a Bundeswehr podcast names an Oberstabsgefreiter Truppfuehrer). The Einsatzersthelfer B is an experienced Hauptgefreiter (the course builds on Einsatzersthelfer A).

Dismounted Panzergrenadierzug (M6 first playable, owner: platoon against platoon): three Schuetzentrupps and the platoon leader with a radio operator. No official Puma platoon structure was found (search extracts only); a non-official source describes a Zugtrupp and three groups. Owner to correct. M7.2 (owner Q1): four Pumas; each of the first three carries a squad, the fourth the platoon leader and his radio operator. The crews are only used when vehicles are switched on (until M7.4a: &vehicles=1 and the tools scenarios). M10.1: a Sanitaeter (medic) with the Zug headquarters (owner Q-1c), riding in the headquarters Puma. D1 (2026-11-14): every man carries one smoke hand grenade (game value, low; sources do not give the issue per man). M10.4a: the Sanitaeter carries a folding litter. M9.4a (owner M9 round): the Funker carries and flies the platoon's reconnaissance quadcopter with three batteries (who flies it: game assumption, low). Ranks (owner 2026-11-15, "realistic job distribution"): a deployed professional unit of SaZ, so no Gefreiter (3 to 6 months of service) in a combat post; one most typical rank per slot (DECISIONS.md 2026-11-15 realistic ranks; medium at most). Zugfuehrer Leutnant (Wikipedia: Leutnant or Oberleutnant, a Hauptfeldwebel in some platoons); Funker and drone operator Stabsgefreiter; the Sanitaeter a Stabsunteroffizier of the medical service (Fachunteroffizier San, low). The fourth Puma has its own crew template (puma-besatzung-zug): its commander is the Zugtruppfuehrer and deputy platoon leader, a Hauptfeldwebel.

Puma crew (M7): commander, gunner, driver. Ranks are typical, not sourced; personal weapons come with mounting and dismounting (M7.2). M7.2: each crewman carries a G36 with three magazines, helmet and vest (game value, low; crews' personal weapons are not in the public sources read). Ranks (owner 2026-11-15, "realistic job distribution"): a deployed professional unit of SaZ, so no Gefreiter (3 to 6 months of service) in a combat post; one most typical rank per slot (DECISIONS.md 2026-11-15 realistic ranks; medium at most). Kommandant = Gruppenfuehrer, Feldwebel (a Bundeswehr podcast names a Hauptfeldwebel Puma commander); Richtschuetze Unteroffizier; Fahrer Hauptgefreiter.

Crew of the Zug headquarters Puma (owner 2026-11-15, realistic ranks): as puma-besatzung, but its commander is the Zugtruppfuehrer, the deputy platoon leader (Hauptfeldwebel; 1966 table: deputy an Unteroffizier mit Portepee, battleorder.org; Bundeswehr podcast: a Hauptfeldwebel Puma commander). Fixed callsign Puma 4 (the fourth Puma of the Zug).

Boxer ambulance crew (M10.6-data): commander, driver and a medic (ARTEC brochure, search extract). Ranks and the rifles' loads are game values (medics are armed for self-defence, owner answer 8). Not in any platoon: ambulances come from off the map (M10.6a). Members in crew-seat order (commander, medic, driver), so a lab without placements seats them as the template names. Ranks (owner 2026-11-15, "realistic job distribution"): a deployed professional unit of SaZ, so no Gefreiter (3 to 6 months of service) in a combat post; one most typical rank per slot (DECISIONS.md 2026-11-15 realistic ranks; medium at most). The Notfallsanitaeter of the Boxer ambulance is in the Feldwebel career (bundeswehr.de, Notfallsanitaeterin) - Feldwebel; driver Hauptgefreiter. Review fix 2026-11-15 (game values, low): every crewman wears the red cross armband (medical transport personnel, GC I art. 24 and 40), and the medic carries a medic bag with the platoon medic's kit in smaller numbers (care given on foot, e.g. after a bail-out; loading at the nest stays abstracted).

M8.3a: one 120 mm tube and its crew of four (leader with the radio and the smoke rounds, gunner with the tube, two loaders with six HE rounds each): 12 HE + 4 smoke at the tube. Crew and rounds at the position are game values (low); the Bundeswehr mortar platoon's organisation was not found in search extracts. Ranks (owner 2026-11-15, "realistic job distribution"): a deployed professional unit of SaZ, so no Gefreiter (3 to 6 months of service) in a combat post; one most typical rank per slot (DECISIONS.md 2026-11-15 realistic ranks; medium at most).

M7.6d: a GMW team on foot of three (Truppfuehrer, Richtschuetze, Ladeschuetze: Bundeswehr GMW page, medium) with the gun on its tripod and three boxes of 32. Its place in the Jaegerkompanie is not sourced (low): data and lab only, in no generated battle.
M8.3a: two 120 mm tubes (an on-map mortar section of the battalion's mortar platoon; game organisation, low).

Leopard 2A7V crew (M7.6a): commander, gunner, loader, driver (published). Ranks are typical, not sourced. Each carries a G36 with two magazines, helmet and vest (low: the real personal weapons, MP7 and P8, are not in the data).

M7.6b: two Leopard 2A7V, a Halbzug (half of a four-tank Panzerzug; medium, from search extracts only). Attaching one to a Panzergrenadier platoon's attack as an overwatch section is a game value (low).

GTK Boxer crew (M7.6c): commander, who works the FLW 200 from inside, and driver (Bundeswehr GTK page 'max 10 persons' with one group of eight in the back; the 2-man crew is an inference, low). Each carries a G36 with three magazines, helmet and vest as the Puma crews (game value, low). Ranks as the Puma crew's (realistic ranks, owner 2026-11-15): Kommandant Feldwebel, Fahrer Hauptgefreiter.
Crew of a GTK Boxer with the 40 mm GMW (M7.6d): as boxer-besatzung; the station's weapon is the only difference.

Crew of the Jaegerzug headquarters Boxer (M7.6c): as boxer-besatzung, but its commander is the Zugtruppfuehrer, the deputy platoon leader (Hauptfeldwebel, as puma-besatzung-zug). Fixed callsign Boxer 4.

Dismounted Jaegergruppe of a GTK Boxer (M7.6c, slice 41): eight men, the GTK's eight places behind its two crew (Bundeswehr GTK page: at most ten persons, the rear holding 'one infantry group with weapons and equipment'). No official strength (STAN) was found; the composition is an inference (low) from a Bundeswehr exercise text (a covering group with Panzerfaust and 40 mm, an MG group, an assault group) and the two-man MG5 team (Bundeswehr 'Maschinengewehrschuetze Jaegerkompanie'). G36 rifles: Boxer units lag the Puma units in modernisation (battleorder.org, search extract). One Einsatzersthelfer B per Gruppe (binding medical answer). Loads copied from the Panzergrenadier Schuetzentrupp (game values, low); the Gruppenfuehrer a Feldwebel (he dismounts; the Puma's Gruppenfuehrer commands the vehicle), the rifleman an Obergefreiter.

Jaegerzug in GTK Boxers (M7.6c, slice 41): the Zugtrupp (Zugfuehrer, Funker with the platoon's quadcopter, Sanitaeter with the litter, as the Panzergrenadierzug's) and three Jaegergruppen, in four Boxers: each of the first three carries a Gruppe, the fourth the Zugtrupp (mirrors pzgren-zug; no official table found, the four-vehicle platoon is an inference, low). 35 men. Ranks as the Panzergrenadierzug's. M7.6d: Boxer 1 and Boxer 3 carry the 40 mm GMW, Boxer 2 and the headquarters Boxer 4 the 12.7 mm (the station takes either; the command variant only the 12.7 mm: Bundeswehr GTK page, medium; the two-and-two mix is a game value, low).
